risks: Lazy-loaded section scripts (GSAP, ScrollTrigger, page-flip) depend on IntersectionObserver firing correctly; if rootMargin is too small or network is extremely slow, initial scroll might hit uninitialized sections. Mitigation: 200px rootMargin provides early loading buffer.

story__progress visibility toggling relies on body.is-in-story class from ScrollTrigger; if reduced-motion is enabled, the class is never added (progress stays hidden) — this is intended behavior per spec.

Font discipline: --font-mono CSS variable still declared in tokens.css but no Google Font loads it; sections using var(--font-mono) will fall back to system monospace (via 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace stack). This is acceptable per spec (≤2 families loaded).
